svg.aria-label: Wrong edges seeded into the graph, falsely confirmed by the grader
svg.title: Wrong edges seeded into the graph, falsely confirmed by the grader
svg.text: Seeded wrong edges the oracle grader falsely confirmed
seeded wrong edges across 19 compiler-graded cells in 4 languages (Go, Java, Rust, TypeScript). Every
cell grades a poisoned twin of its own export — each edge re-targeted to a declaration the oracle never
resolved that site to — and the grader refused or left unjudged every one; it confirmed none.
Precision-against-oracle on the 39 compiler-graded cells (dagger's 19 Go modules counted one each):
36 at 100% — confirmed equals graded, 0 contradicted. The exceptions, printed because they are what make the number
believable:
ajv (TypeScript): 1,375/1,378 = 99.8% — the one open semantic defect: a member call on a union-typed receiver
drawn to one member's method (static→union-member, a scip-typescript shape; n=2 repos with hono)
hono (tsconfig.build.json) (TypeScript): 767/774 = 99.1% — a draw of repowise's G4 experiment on our key; the 7
contradictions are ajv's static→union-member shape (`c.toString()` on a Child union drawn to JSXNode.toString),
the open scip-typescript defect, n=2 repos
quic-go (Go): 3,766/3,781 = 99.6% — random draw; binary roots only (the full test program OOM-killed the box);
all 15 contradictions are the test build's shadowing methods, 0 hobbes-wrong
Trace-graded cells (Python — the interpreter under the repo's own suite): 0 of 5,636 seeded wrong edges falsely
confirmed across 2 cells. A refusal there is 'suspect', never a contradiction: the interpreter confirms and cannot
contradict (C-60), so those cells are kept out of the headline sum.
Not in the sum: dagger, kbet (private app) — graded before the poison check existed (kbet), or the record quotes the
check per module and does not sum it (dagger).
Precision-against-oracle is a lower bound: contradictions mostly triage to the oracle's own grain, and the triage ratio is
quoted per cell (A-8).
Every number is read from docs/oracle-cells/ by bench/oracle/report/render.py (ADR-102); the answer keys are compilers Hobbes does not
control (ADR-089): x/tools RTA for Go, tsc for TypeScript, rustc's MIR for Rust, javac with CHA for Java.
